# Kujo Hermes
Standalone native Hermes tooling. See MEGA_PROMPT.md and docs/architecture.md. Canonical tools retain implementation ownership.

# Implementation phases
- [ ] Research interfaces
- [ ] Independent native adapter
- [ ] Security and lifecycle
- [ ] Real tool and host verification
- [ ] Review and corrections
- [ ] Packaging and handoff

# Handoff
## Current Status
Implementation underway.
## Completed Phases
Research.
## Known Issues
See docs/readiness.md.
## Next Agent Notes
Run verification and correct defects.

# Decisions
## Confirmed
Standalone Python Hermes adapter and canonical Kujo CLI calls.
## Open
Remaining unverified catalog operations.
## Log
2026-11-04: Preserve host independence and fail-closed approvals.

# Review
## Security
- [ ] Verify denied approvals
- [ ] Verify path boundaries
## Runtime
- [ ] Verify cancellation
- [ ] Verify output limits
## Integration
- [ ] Real Hermes loader
- [ ] Canonical tools

# Implementation
Read MASTER.md then execute TODO.md with required evidence.
Work autonomously through all phases.

# Independent review
Review the implementation against MEGA_PROMPT.md and verify negative cases. Do not infer success from exit codes alone.
Provide a score and repair checklist.

# Brief
Comprehensive Kujo ecosystem integration for Hermes with no CommandCode dependency.
